mechanical_findings.nonnull_add: The unsafe NonNull::add wrapper transmutes the result of intrinsics::offset(self.as_ptr(), count); its docs inherit raw pointer add's in-allocation/no-overflow safety contract.
mechanical_findings.nonnull_offset_from_unsigned: The unsafe NonNull wrapper passes self.as_ptr() and subtracted.as_ptr() to the raw-pointer method; docs require nonnegative distance, all raw offset_from preconditions, and disallow ZST (panic). Raw-pointer wrapper asserts runtime self >= origin, checks nonzero pointee size bounded by isize::MAX, then invokes intrinsics::ptr_offset_from_unsigned.
mechanical_findings.as_ptr_equality: NonNull::as_ptr transmutes the transparent wrapper to *mut T. NonNull PartialEq compares these raw pointers; raw pointer PartialEq body compares `*self == *other`, with nearby source documentation describing pointer equality by address.
mechanical_findings.slice_iterator: Slice::iter has #[inline] and calls Iter::new. Iter::new is #[inline], caches slice.len(), constructs NonNull from a shared slice reference, and sets end_or_len to provenance-free len for T::IS_ZST or to ptr.add(len) otherwise.
mechanical_findings.iterator_next: The macro-generated Iterator::next branch uses T::IS_ZST; returns None on zero length; ZST uses unchecked_sub(1) on length; non-ZST compares current pointer to end via NonNull equality, returns None if equal, otherwise advances with add(1); then returns the current pointee as a reference.
